symptom: ako/mxcli#2064: under `run --local --watch` (Mendix 11.16.0) an incremental mxbuild --serve build failed with CE0108 "Variable 'Latest' is defined but not in scope at this location" on an mxcli-written microflow (a variable a call creates, used after a decision), while `docker check` reported 0 errors and the next build on a fresh serve process applied the same model. Three times in one session, not deterministic; the loop stayed on 'build #N FAILED' until something forced a full build.
cause: mxbuild --serve's incremental state, as far as can be told: the same bytes pass a full build. serveRecovery already restarted serve for failures known to be process state (the 11.14 client-source shape, a stale CE6093 theme error) but took every other failure as the model's.
insight: The verdict on a suspect failure belongs to the tool, not to a heuristic: rebuild on a fresh process and let that answer stand, which is the stale-theme pattern already in serveRecovery. Two costs to bound: scope it to codes actually seen lying (CE0108 only), since each recheck is a ~25 s cold build on a genuine error; and remember a fresh-process-confirmed error signature so a user fixing a real CE0108 pays one recheck, not one per save, cleared by the next passing build. Callers route only post-boot builds through serveRecovery, so 'not restartPending' means incremental. Control: with the branch disabled, the scripted test returns the incremental CE0108 although the full build passed. Not reproduced live: the report is non-deterministic.
